data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates 'a mutation that would pass silently today' with a type-coercion fallback (`identity or default_identity`) that may or may not exist in the current code; the problem requires the forbidden case to name a mutation that passes the suite AS CURRENTLY WRITTEN. But the countercondition 'If the frozen seat identity itself is falsey, the mutation and fixture produce an indeterminate match' is self-undermining: if a frozen lease alone suffices and the frozen seat is falsey, the fixture itself yields indeterminacy — exactly the kind of fixture pathology the problem warns against when it demands fixtures avoid rebuilding a full manifest where a frozen lease alone suffices. A forbidden case whose own countercondition admits indeterminacy cannot be machine-checkable, violating the rubric-only requirement.
